'''Fukuyama Hachimangū''' (福山八幡宮, ''Fukuyama Hachimangū'') is a [[Shinto]] shrine located in {{ill|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|en|Fukuyama, Hiroshima|qid=Q661038|lt=Fukuyama, Hiroshima}} Prefecture, Japan. It is a [[Hachiman shrine|Hachiman Shrine]], dedicated to the [[kami]] [[Hachiman]]. The [[kami]] it enshrines include {{ill|Emperor Ōjin|en|Emperor Ōjin|qid=Q317997|lt=Emperor Ōjin}}, {{ill|Empress Jingū|en|Empress Jingū|qid=Q232803|lt=Empress Jingū}}, and Himegami (比売神).
